recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-full shot of a female subject leaning against a vintage car at night, characterized by a warm, reddish-brown color grade and high-contrast lighting that emphasizes leather textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned left-of-center against a dark, receding background
Text block anchored in the upper-right negative space
Diagonal line of the car hood leading the eye from bottom-left to center
Texture contrast between matte skin and reflective black leather

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist-up to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the reflective lapels of the leather jacket.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the jacket's diagonal lines, then right to the stacked typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy darkness on the right side provides a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream/off-white for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted terracotta or burnt orange for the secondary subtitle text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a heavy red/yellow tint in the shadows; high value contrast on the subject's face.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and blacks

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
Ball terminals on lowercase letters like 'j' and 'y'
Custom flourishes or swashes on terminal ends
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'j' with an exaggerated curly tail
Lowercase 'n' with a soft, rounded shoulder
Lowercase 'a' with a distinct teardrop terminal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast decorative serif paired with a more standard, legible serif in a contrasting warm hue.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegant serif structure.
Modern serif with similar ball terminals and weight distribution.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a woman in a black leather jacket leaning on a dark vintage car at night. Use low-key lighting with a warm, reddish-brown color grade. Ensure the right side of the frame is dark and empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the artist name in a stacked, right-aligned high-contrast serif font in cream. Place the title below it in a smaller serif font in terracotta orange. Use all lowercase.

verificationChecks: Is the color grade consistently warm/reddish?
Are the leather textures visible and reflective?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red color tint
Specific model of the vintage car
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast in the serif font strokes
Ensure the subject's face is the primary focal point
Verify the warm, sepia-like color balance
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Night Portrait + Vintage Car + High-Contrast Serif Typography + Warm Monochrome Tint
